Name: More Books DSHi Style
Author: MurplyTheDerp
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Retextures the books from Vladislavjzk's More Books mod[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Download the zipped file, and unzip its full contents into your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]See original mod for function of books; this mod simply retextures the original![/color]
